title: Middle East war live:  Iran threatens to disrupt Gulf trade in response to US naval blockade
summary: The leader of Iran’s joint military command threatened Wednesday to halt trade in the Gulf region if the US does not lift its blockade of Iranian ports. Even so, US President Donald Trump said the war in Iran was “very close to over” in an interview that aired Wednesday. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: An official source in the Lebanese government has contradicted US President Donald Trump’s claim that the leaders of Lebanon and Israel are set to talk on Thursday, saying that Beirut is “not aware” of any upcoming contact between the two. Israel has also backed the US's claim, but did not give a timetable for the talks. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
